ideas.title: The Scope of Minnesota's Fraud Problem
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota, including the number of cases, amount of money involved, and types of fraud.
questions: What is the total amount of fraud in Minnesota?
What types of fraud are most common?
ideas.insight: Understanding the scope of Minnesota's fraud problem will help identify areas for improvement and inform prevention efforts.

ideas.title: Healthcare-Related Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate healthcare-related fraud in Minnesota, including Medicaid scams and other types of healthcare fraud.
questions: What are the most common types of healthcare-related fraud in Minnesota?
How much money is involved in these cases?
ideas.insight: Healthcare-related fraud is a significant problem in Minnesota, and understanding its scope and nature can inform prevention efforts.
